THE COUSRT DISMISSES THIS CASE WITHOUT PREJUDICE WITH REGARD TO DEFENDAN VALERIE JUDD. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
